senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to breathe, pant,] to fear; to be anxious.
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 9:1">Esth. R. to V, 1</cite> <he>למה תִפְחְדִי</he> why art thou afraid? <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 14:6">Midr. Till. to Ps. XIV</cite> <he>שלא פָחֲדוּ מן וכ׳</he> that they were not afraid of the Lord; a. e.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 8:7">Esth. R. to IV, 15</cite> <he>היתה אסתר נִפְחֶדֶת מאוד וכ׳</he> Esther was greatly excited on account of the evil &c. Cant. R. to III, 8 <he>מתיראין ומזדעזעין ונִפְחָדִין</he> afraid, trembling, and excited; a. e.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16">Num. R. s. 16</cite> <he>כשמבקשין להַפְחִידוֹ</he> when they want to frighten the child, v. <cite ref="T00977"><he>רְצוּעָה</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="Q00443">same</cite>. Part. pass. <he>מְפוּחָד</he>; pl. <he>מְפוּחָדִים</he>. Sifra B’har, Par. 3, ch. IV (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 25:19">Lev. XXV, 19</cite>) <he>לא מפוזרים ולא מפ׳</he> neither scattered, nor frightened.
to be afraid; to be joyously excited; to await with anxiety.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite> <he>ולא היו מתיראים ולא מִתְפַּחֲדִים</he> and they were neither afraid, nor excited; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 795">Yalk. Ps. 795</cite>.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1">Deut. R. s. 1</cite>, end <he>מתייראין ומִתְפַּחֲדִין מכם</he> trembled and were afraid of you.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 9:5">Ab. d’R. N. ch. IX</cite> <he>שיהא לבו של־אדם מִתְפַּחֵד וכ׳</he> that a man’s heart should be afraid (of an evil occurrence) every day.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48:6">Gen. R. s. 48</cite> <he>זה מִתְפַּחֵד לומר איזו פרוקופי וכ׳</he> the one is excited thinking what the distinction will be which the king is to confer upon me; <he>וזה מתפ׳ ואומר איזה דין וכ׳</he> and the other is excited thinking what the judgment will be &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 304">Yalk. Is. 304</cite>. Tanḥ. Lekh 15 <he>אתם מתפחדין על הטוב וכ׳</he> you will be excited with joy over the good which is reserved for you (ref. to <he>ופחדו</he>, <cite ref="Hosea 3:5">Hos. III, 5</cite>). Cant. R. l. c.; a. fr.
